question: Where was the first-ever ‘Himalayan High-Altitude Atmospheric & Climate Centre’ launched?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Udhampur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister Jitendra Singh Inaugurates First Himalayan Climate Centre in Udhampur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Union Minister Jitendra Singh** launched the **first-ever Himalayan High-Altitude Atmospheric & Climate Centre** in **Nathatop, Udhampur district, J&K**.

 
 
• 
 
The centre aims to **provide accurate climate and weather forecasts** and **conduct research on the region’s high-altitude conditions**.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative is under the **Ministry of Earth Sciences**.

 
 
• 
 
The project will significantly **enhance climate monitoring** in the **Himalayas**, addressing the unique weather conditions of the region.
